Entire character centered with 10 percent TRANSPARENT padding, all sword and hair tips inside frame. No ground, no shadow, no aura, no extra objects, no floating interface.

Replace ALL of that noisy ground texture with smooth broad calm clean green COLOR AREAS like the quiet open terrain of reference 2: one dominant medium muted meadow green, with very occasional broad softly irregular slightly darker or lighter patches.
